raw_segments.text: When Midia was summoned from his cell, he always went downstairs, to the place set aside
As Alyosha entered the room he came upon Rakuten, who was just taking leave of Midia.
Midia was laughing heartily as he saw him out, while Rakuten seemed grumbling.
Rakuten did not like meeting Alyosha, especially of late.
He scarcely spoke to him and bowed to him stiffly.
Seeing Alyosha enter now, he frowned and looked away, as though he were entirely absorbed
in buttoning his big, warm, fur-trimmed overcoat.
Then he began looking at once for his umbrella.
